title: Delivery ID
description: Unique identifier for a Delivery, returned by `POST /deliveries`. The server mints a new ID for the non-hazardous Delivery; a hazardous Movement's Delivery reuses its Movement ID. Format: a two-digit year prefix followed by six or seven characters from A–Z and 0–9, 8 or 9 characters in all. Movement IDs and Delivery IDs share this format. Treat it as opaque: don't parse it.
